```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Clean ---------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

# Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
# region Libraries_and_settings
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(knitr)

options(knitr.table.format = "latex")

# Design: SES-adjusted school value-added for the 2016 10th-grade cohort. The
# school fixed effect from a regression of standardized 10th-grade mathematics
# on standardized 8th-grade mathematics and reading, sex, mother's education,
# household income, prior grade repetition, and residential-commune fixed
# effects. Complete-case over the control set. The output feeds the
# value-added split in 3_effect_sae_am.Rmd.
simce_year <- 2016
# endregion
```

```{r functions_to_standardize, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# region standardization_helpers

# standardize within year
zyr <- function(x, g) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  (x - ave(x, g, FUN = function(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE))) /
    ave(x, g, FUN = function(v) sd(v, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# 0, 99 and 999 are non-response codes in the parent questionnaire
to_na <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x[x %in% c(0, 99, 999)] <- NA
  x
}
# endregion
```

# Scores

```{r cohort_scores, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# 2016 10th-grade SIMCE takers, one row per student; mathematics is the outcome
m2 <- readRDS("data/panel_simce_2m.rds")
setDT(m2)
m2 <- m2[
  agno == simce_year & !is.na(mrun) & !is.na(rbd),
  .(mrun = as.numeric(mrun), idalumno = as.numeric(idalumno), rbd = as.numeric(rbd),
    gen_alu, mate2m = ptje_mate2m_alu)
]
setorder(m2, mrun)
m2 <- m2[, .SD[1L], by = mrun]

# gen_alu stores 2 or "Mujeres" for female depending on the vintage
m2[, female := as.integer(gen_alu %in% c("2", "Mujeres"))]

# 8th-grade priors: the first SIMCE 8B record per student
b8 <- readRDS("data/panel_simce_8b.rds")
setDT(b8)
b8 <- b8[!is.na(mrun), .(mrun = as.numeric(mrun), agno8b = agno,
                         mate8b = ptje_mate8b_alu, lect8b = ptje_lect8b_alu)]
setorder(b8, mrun, agno8b)
b8 <- b8[, .SD[1L], by = mrun]
```

# Controls

```{r panel_controls, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- Step 1: read the panel and drop columns we don't need ---
# This shrinks memory BEFORE any subset copy.
df <- readRDS("data/panel_9-12_2010_2021.rds")
setDT(df)

keep_cols <- c("MRUN", "AGNO", "SIT_FIN_R", "COD_COM_ALU")
keep_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, names(df))
drop_cols <- setdiff(names(df), keep_cols)
if (length(drop_cols) > 0L) df[, (drop_cols) := NULL]
rm(drop_cols, keep_cols)
gc()

# --- Step 2: repetition and residential commune ---
# repeated = ever repeated a grade over the student's full record; for this
# cohort those records sit in grades 1-8 (they were promoted through to reach
# 10th by 2016), so it is a pre-treatment control. Residential commune: the
# 2016 record, else the first non-missing one.
df[, mrunN := as.numeric(MRUN)]
sub <- df[mrunN %in% m2$mrun]

rep_ever <- sub[, .(repeated = as.integer(any(SIT_FIN_R == "R", na.rm = TRUE))), by = mrunN]
com16 <- sub[AGNO == simce_year & !is.na(COD_COM_ALU), .(comuna_stu = as.integer(COD_COM_ALU[1L])), by = mrunN]
comfb <- sub[!is.na(COD_COM_ALU), .(comuna_fb = as.integer(COD_COM_ALU[1L])), by = mrunN]
comm <- merge(comfb, com16, by = "mrunN", all = TRUE)
comm[, comuna_stu := fifelse(is.na(comuna_stu), comuna_fb, comuna_stu)]
comm[, comuna_fb := NULL]

cov <- merge(rep_ever, comm, by = "mrunN", all = TRUE)
setnames(cov, "mrunN", "mrun")
rm(df, sub, rep_ever, com16, comfb, comm)
gc()

# --- Step 3: mother's education (p08) and household income (p10) ---
# From the 2016 parent questionnaire, joined by idalumno
cp <- fread("data/simce2m2016_cpad_privada_final_SEG.csv", sep = "|",
            select = c("idalumno", "cpad_p08", "cpad_p10"))
cp[, `:=`(idalumno = as.numeric(idalumno),
          educ_madre = to_na(cpad_p08), income = to_na(cpad_p10))]

# idalumno must be unique before the student-level join
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cp$idalumno))
```

# Value-added

```{r value_added_estimation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
d <- merge(m2, b8, by = "mrun", all.x = TRUE)
d <- merge(d, cov, by = "mrun", all.x = TRUE)
d <- merge(d, cp[, .(idalumno, educ_madre, income)], by = "idalumno", all.x = TRUE)
rm(m2, b8, cov, cp)
gc()

# Scores standardized once on the full 2016-with-scores cohort; the regression
# then runs on the complete cases over the control set (listwise).
d[, `:=`(mate2m_z = zyr(mate2m, simce_year),
         mate8b_z = zyr(mate8b, agno8b),
         lect8b_z = zyr(lect8b, agno8b))]

cc <- d[!is.na(mate2m_z) & !is.na(mate8b_z) & !is.na(lect8b_z) & !is.na(female) &
          !is.na(educ_madre) & !is.na(income) & !is.na(repeated) & !is.na(comuna_stu)]

m <- feols(
  mate2m_z ~ mate8b_z + lect8b_z + female +
    i(educ_madre) + i(income) + repeated + i(comuna_stu) | rbd,
  data = cc
)

fe <- fixef(m)$rbd
va <- data.table(rbd = as.numeric(names(fe)), va = as.numeric(fe))

fwrite(va, "data/va_2016_gazmuri.csv")
```
